_ordering_rationale: Ordre PV : revenus totaux = scale Cigna (PBM + assurance), revenus Pharmacy Evernorth = moteur croissance, medical members = base assurance, MCR = profitabilite assurance, Evernorth income = qualite segments, premiums = stabilite.

kpis.signal: Bond 2024 porte par Pharmacy/Express Scripts, sortie progressive Medicare Advantage
kpis.description_fr: CA total Cigna : Pharmacy revenues (PBM Express Scripts) + Premiums (assurance) + Fees + Investment income.
kpis.description_en: Total Cigna revenue: Pharmacy (PBM Express Scripts) + Premiums (insurance) + Fees + Investment income.

kpis.signal: Acceleration 2024 portee par Centene (nouveau client PBM), GLP-1 utilisation
kpis.description_fr: CA Pharmacy issu d'Evernorth Health Services (Express Scripts PBM). Plus gros segment Cigna par CA, croissance volume + mix.
kpis.description_en: Pharmacy revenue from Evernorth Health Services (Express Scripts PBM). Cigna's largest segment by revenue, volume + mix growth.

kpis.signal: Leger recul 2024 lie a la cession Medicare a HCSC en cours
kpis.description_fr: Nombre de clients couverts par Cigna Healthcare (commercial ASO + insured + Medicare). Base assurance.
kpis.description_en: Customers covered by Cigna Healthcare (commercial ASO + insured + Medicare). Insurance base.

kpis.signal: MCR en hausse 2024, pression utilisation post-COVID, deterioration profitabilite assurance
kpis.description_fr: MCR = couts medicaux / primes. Plus bas = plus profitable. Cible managed care ~80%. Indicateur risque souscription.
kpis.description_en: MCR = medical costs / premiums. Lower = more profitable. Managed care target ~80%. Underwriting risk metric.

kpis.signal: Croissance moderee, mix favorable commercial vs cession progressive Medicare
kpis.description_fr: Primes d'assurance perçues (Cigna Healthcare + Other Operations). Segment moins volatil que Pharmacy.
kpis.description_en: Insurance premiums collected (Cigna Healthcare + Other Operations). Less volatile than Pharmacy.

kpis.signal: Profitabilite Evernorth en hausse reguliere, segment moteur de l'EBIT
kpis.description_fr: Resultat ajuste avant impot du segment Evernorth Health Services (PBM, specialty, care services). Indicateur qualite mix segment dominant.
kpis.description_en: Pre-tax adjusted income from operations of Evernorth Health Services segment (PBM, specialty, care services). Dominant-segment quality indicator.
